RG Kar Case: Victim's Mother Expresses Dissatisfaction with CBI Probe

The mother of a victim in the RG Kar Medical College and Hospital case has expressed dissatisfaction with the progress of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe, stating that the justice process is not moving forward. BJP MLA Ratna Debnath, whose daughter was the victim, also questioned the slow pace of the CBI investigation. Both the mother and the MLA are reportedly unhappy with the current status of the investigation into the incident at RG Kar Medical College and Hospital.
